entities.note: horizontal 20x4-px bar (5 cells x 1 at 4 px per cell) at rows 16-19, cols 12-31; colour 9 = the selected bar (an unselected bar would be colour 8; L1 has only this one); the arrows move it one cell = 4 px
4x4 colour-4 cell at rows 0-3, cols 36-39 (its top row is hidden under the step bar): the tap the water comes out of; never moves
4x4 colour-6 water cell directly under the spout at rows 4-7, cols 36-39; on ACTION5 it becomes a stream of colour-6 cells falling straight down; the bar cannot move into it

two colour-11 U-shapes (3x2 cells = 12x8 px) at rows 52-59, cols 16-27 and cols 40-51; the openings are the 4-px-wide hollows at cols 20-23 and 44-47 (rows 52-55); a cup the stream falls into turns colour 13 = filled; bars may not touch a cup's neighbourhood

colour-1 floor rows 60-63 (full width): any water reaching it turns it colour 14 and the pour FAILS (flash, water removed, fills cleared, failure counter +1); 4 failed pours followed by another ACTION5 = game over; bars cannot enter it
row 0: colour 14 from the left = remaining steps (64 px = 30, about 2 px per action), black(0) grows in from the right; every action including clicks and pours costs 1

rules.note: selected bar up one cell (4 px); costs 1 step
a bar may not go above display row 12 (the top 3 cells), off the sides, into the floor, the spout or the drop; the step is still spent (same for ACTION2/3/4)
a move that would put the bar within one cell of a cup is refused (same for the other arrows); other bars/deflectors (L2+) may be overlapped

POUR (costs 1 step): the drop becomes a stream that falls straight down until blocked; on hitting a bar it spreads along the bar's top and falls off BOTH ends; entering a cup's opening fills the cup; hitting a cup's arm splits sideways; hitting the floor = failed pour. Bars do not move; the layout stays for the next attempt
a cup the stream falls into turns colour 13; if the pour fails all cups revert to 11
floor cells hit by water turn colour 14 = fail (reverted after the flash)
clicking inside a bar's box selects it (colour 9; the previous selection returns to 8); with a single bar nothing visibly changes; costs 1 step
a click anywhere else changes nothing and still costs 1 step

goal.note: after one pour every cup must be filled (colour 13) and no water may have touched the floor; the bar must be moved right 3 cells (to cols 24-43, spanning both cup openings' gap) so the stream splits into both cups; minimum 4 actions (ACTION4 x3, ACTION5)
